moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Underway
moments.blurb: The twin music festivals, Reading and Leeds, are in full swing this Bank Holiday weekend, running from August 27th to 30th, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is officially ON! Who are you buzzing to see this weekend? Drop your must-catch acts below!

angles.name: Headline Highlight
angles.copy: From Fontaines D.C. to Florence + The Machine, the rock and indie legends are owning Reading & Leeds this Bank Holiday. Who's bringing the noise for you?

moments.title: Bon Jovi's 'Forever Tour' Hits UK
